dinner.name: Estonian Meatballs (Lihamunad)
dinner.description: Estonian meatballs with sour cream sauce - Baltic comfort food
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
For sauce: 2 tablespoons butter, 2 tablespoons flour, 300ml beef stock, 200ml sour cream, 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard, salt and pepper
instructions: Soak bread in milk for 5 minutes
Combine ground beef, pork, soaked bread, finely diced onion, egg
Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
Brown meatballs on all sides (about 10-12 minutes total), working in batches
Make sauce: melt butter in same skillet
Sprinkle flour, cook 1 minute stirring constantly
Gradually add beef stock, whisking to avoid lumps
Whisk sour cream and mustard together
Slowly stir into sauce (don't boil or sour cream will curdle)
Serve with boiled potatoes or egg noodles
dinner.notes: Sour cream should never boil. Cold milk-soaked bread keeps meatballs tender
dinner.fun_fact: Estonian meatballs are often served with lingonberry jam on the side
